<svg width="1200" height="520" viewBox="0 0 1200 520" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <pattern id="grid" width="40" height="40" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M40 0H0V40" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.045" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="48%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silver" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#c9c9cc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6f6f74"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="silver2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d8d8da"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a8a8f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="line" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a8a8f" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a8a8f" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="lineR" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a8a8f" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a8a8f" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Fondo -->
  <rect width="1200" height="520" fill="#060605"/>
  <rect width="1200" height="520" fill="url(#grid)"/>
  <rect width="1200" height="520" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Cuadrados flotantes -->
  <g fill="#ffffff">
    <g transform="translate(110 70) rotate(20)"><rect x="-9" y="-9" width="18" height="18" opacity="0.18"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.28;0.05" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -18;0 0" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(460 40) rotate(35)"><rect x="-7" y="-7" width="14" height="14" opacity="0.15"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.25;0.05" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -14;0 0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(905 85) rotate(15)"><rect x="-11" y="-11" width="22" height="22" opacity="0.16"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.26;0.05" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -20;0 0" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(1040 255) rotate(40)"><rect x="-8" y="-8" width="16" height="16" opacity="0.14"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.04;0.22;0.04" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -16;0 0" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(300 255) rotate(25)"><rect x="-12" y="-12" width="24" height="24" opacity="0.17"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.27;0.05" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -22;0 0" dur="11s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(160 420) rotate(10)"><rect x="-10" y="-10" width="20" height="20" opacity="0.15"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.04;0.24;0.04" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -18;0 0" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(1110 410) rotate(30)"><rect x="-8" y="-8" width="16" height="16" opacity="0.13"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.04;0.2;0.04" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -12;0 0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(690 470) rotate(45)"><rect x="-13" y="-13" width="26" height="26" opacity="0.15"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.05;0.25;0.05" dur="10s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -24;0 0" dur="12s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(880 330) rotate(18)"><rect x="-7" y="-7" width="14" height="14" opacity="0.12"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.03;0.2;0.03" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -14;0 0" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
    <g transform="translate(60 250) rotate(28)"><rect x="-6" y="-6" width="12" height="12" opacity="0.12"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.03;0.2;0.03" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" values="0 0;0 -12;0 0" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g>
  </g>

  <!-- Línea superior -->
  <rect x="330" y="104" width="70" height="1" fill="url(#line)"/>
  <rect x="800" y="104" width="70" height="1" fill="url(#lineR)"/>
  <text x="600" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" letter-spacing="3.2" fill="#8a8a8f">MEDELLÍN, COLOMBIA  ·  DISPONIBLE AHORA</text>

  <!-- Medallón -->
  <circle cx="600" cy="188" r="50" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.04" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.18" stroke-width="1.5">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-opacity" values="0.12;0.3;0.12" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <text x="600" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'UnifrakturCook','Old English Text MT','Blackadder ITC','Goudy Text MT',Georgia,serif" font-size="62" fill="url(#silver)">F</text>

  <!-- Nombre -->
  <text x="600" y="355" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'UnifrakturCook','Old English Text MT','Blackadder ITC','Goudy Text MT',Georgia,serif" font-size="150" fill="url(#silver)">Frank</text>

  <!-- Apellidos -->
  <text x="600" y="413" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Bebas Neue','Oswald','Arial Narrow','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="11" fill="url(#silver2)">JUNIOR BENÍTEZ MOSQUERA</text>

  <!-- Subtítulo -->
  <text x="600" y="467" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" letter-spacing="3.5" fill="#77777c">ANÁLISIS &amp; DESARROLLO DE SOFTWARE   ·   CREATIVE TECHNOLOGIST</text>
</svg>
